meta.name: seo-page
meta.description: Deep single-page SEO analysis covering on-page elements, content quality, technical meta tags, schema, images, and performance. Use when user says "analyze this page", "check page SEO", "single URL", "check this page", "page analysis", or provides a single URL for review.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析单页SEO表现，优化排名
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要对单个网页进行深度SEO诊断
copy.tagline_en: Analyze single-page SEO performance to boost rankings
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need deep SEO analysis for a single webpage

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会分析你提供的单个网页，从页面元素、内容质量、技术标签、结构化数据、图片和性能等方面给出评分和改进建议。
howto.when: 当你要求分析某个网页的 SEO 时触发，例如说“分析这个页面”、“检查页面 SEO”或直接提供一个网址。

say.note: Claude 会给出页面评分和问题列表。

say.text: 检查这个页面的技术标签和结构化数据。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes a single webpage you provide, scoring and suggesting improvements for on-page elements, content quality, technical meta tags, schema, images, and performance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze a page's SEO, e.g., say "analyze this page", "check page SEO", or provide a single URL.

say_en.text: Analyze the SEO of this page: https://example.com
say_en.note: Claude will give a score and list issues.

say_en.text: Check the technical tags and schema of this page.
say_en.note: Claude will focus on canonical, Open Graph, and Schema.
